[[File:Monster Examine icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Monster Examine''' is a [[lunar spell]] that requires 66 [[Magic]] plus the quests [[Dream Mentor]] and [[Lunar Diplomacy]] to be cast. It costs 1 [[Mind rune]], 1 [[Cosmic rune]], and 1 [[Astral rune]] to cast and grants 61 Magic experience per cast. There are [[:Category:Monster examine impossible|a few monsters]] in the game which can not be examined by this spell. 

Casting this spell on a [[mountain troll]] south of [[Mount Quidamortem]] is a requirement for the [[hard Kourend]] diary. 
{{clear|left}}

==Trivia==
*Following [[Nex]]'s release, bosses may not have their stats visible when Monster Examine is used on them. This was confirmed by [[Mod Kieren]] to be intentional to add an element of mystery to the bosses.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/rwkclb/nex_the_fifth_general_weekly_game_update_january/hrc9m42/|title=Nex: The Fifth General - Weekly Game Update (January 5th 2022)|quote=Just to confirm this [disabling Monster Examine for Nex] is intentional, we were discussing it only in last week about adding this mystery back. If popular it may be something we do with future bosses too.|date=17 December 2015|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/qQJv2|archivedate=5 January 2022}} The spell was re-enabled in the game update two weeks later.
**[[The Forgotten Four]] later had this apply to them, but only partially; their combat levels and offensive bonuses could be examined, but not their defensive ones. A week after their release, their defensive stats could be seen.
